::: {#bio-text}
I am a **graduate student researcher** in the Department of Statistics and 
Applied Probability at the University of California, Santa Barbara.  My 
research interests lie at the intersection of stochastic control and 
games, quantitative finance, and environmental resource economics.
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const subtitle = document.querySelector(".subtitle");
  if (!subtitle) return;

  // Split the bio into words so each can animate in on its own
  const bio = document.getElementById("bio-text");
  const words = [];
  if (bio) {
    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(bio, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    const nodes = [];
    while (walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
    nodes.forEach(function (node) {
      if (!node.textContent.trim()) return;
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      node.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function (part) {
        if (!part) return;
        if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) {
          frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(part));
        } else {
          const w = document.createElement("span");
          w.className = "bio-word";
          w.textContent = part;
          frag.appendChild(w);
          words.push(w);
        }
      });
      node.parentNode.replaceChild(frag, node);
    });
  }

  const text = subtitle.textContent.trim();
  subtitle.textContent = "";
  subtitle.style.visibility = "visible";

  let i = 0;
  const speed = 45;

  function type() {
    if (i < text.length) {
      subtitle.textContent += text.charAt(i);
      i++;
      setTimeout(type, speed);
    } else {
      // Stop blinking cursor
      subtitle.classList.add("typed-done");

      // 1. Fade in the text panel, then reveal the words one by one
      if (bio) bio.classList.add("bio-in");
      words.forEach(function (w, idx) {
        setTimeout(function () { w.classList.add("bio-word-in"); }, 250 + idx * 28);
      });

      // 2. Pop in buttons one by one once the paragraph is mostly revealed
      const wait = 250 + Math.min(words.length * 28, 1400);
      setTimeout(function () {
        document.querySelectorAll(".about-link").forEach(function (btn, idx) {
          setTimeout(function () {
            btn.classList.add("btn-appear");
          }, idx * 130);
        });
      }, wait);
    }
  }

  type();
});
</script>

<style>
.subtitle::after {
  content: "|";
  animation: blink 0.7s step-end infinite;
}
.subtitle.typed-done::after {
  display: none;
}
@keyframes blink {
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Separator bar removed */
hr.about-sep {
  display: none;
}

/* Readability panel behind the bio text: soft tint, blur and shadow */
#bio-text {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.8s ease-out;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: 14px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
#bio-text.bio-in { opacity: 1; }
body.quarto-light #bio-text {
  background: rgba(252, 252, 252, 0.65);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(76, 79, 105, 0.15);
}
body.quarto-dark #bio-text {
  background: rgba(38, 40, 46, 0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

/* Words rise out of a blur, one after another */
.bio-word {
  display: inline-block;
  opacity: 0;
  filter: blur(8px);
  transform: translateY(0.6em);
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease-out,
              filter 0.6s ease-out,
              transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.bio-word.bio-word-in {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: blur(0);
  transform: none;
}

.about-link {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.75) translateY(6px);
}
.about-link.btn-appear {
  animation: btn-appear 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) forwards;
}
@keyframes btn-appear {
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .bio-word { transition: none; }
}
</style>
